balls.text: he does it again, he's revising that chapter now, full-toss on the middle stump and Hussey's taken his foot down and scooped it over short fine-leg yet again, this time off the bounce to the fence for a four to end an amazing innings
fuller outside the off stump and he taps it through to the off side for a single
comes down the pitch and wants to flay it away, gets it off the toe of the bat through to the covers for a single

whoa, that's a lesson in how to bat in T20 cricket and this is Hussey's chapter, it was a yorker-length ball alright and the batsman gets his front foot forward and spoons it over the short fine-leg for a six! Takes full advantage of the pace of the delivery there...
pulls his length back this time, outside the off stump and tapped down to long-off for a single
what a shot, what a superb shot, that's smashed away, full-toss from Malinga, and Raina's swung and done that quite hard, it's gone 94 metres away for a six!

pulled away for a four, he's been playing a second fiddle for some time to Raina but that was short enough for him to go for the pull, hit off the middle of the bat and goes through to the fine-leg fence
gets back to bowling outside the off stump, length ball too and can get only the toe of the bat through to third-man for a single
the man's in form and there's no doubting that, it was on a length on the middle stump and he just gets his bat-swing away so quickly, over mid-wicket for a four!
chipped over the covers for a single, was full enough to play that one but a tad wide to get full timing on it, on the bounce to Rayadu for a single
bad ball, full-toss and on the middle stump, but got the feeling Raina was looking to hit it hard than time it, gets it only to the square-leg fielder inside the circle
that's from over the stumps and outside the stump, drops his pace to 131 km/hr and he was looking to swing it, gets only a bit of an inside edge to the leg side for a single
but this time Raina does exactly what he wants to, it was a full-toss, outside the off stump and cracked over extra-cover for a four, easily beats the deep fielder
continues to bowl wide and full and wants them to play it to the off side alone, does not get it off the middle of the bat, hit straight to the deep cover fielder
not the best of deliveries there, he gets a full-toss outside the off and tries to caress it through the point area, gets it straight to the fielder for a change
chips down the pitch and gets one that's wide outside the off and very full, gets his bat down in time and taps it to deep cover for a single
yorker length ball and manages to get the bat down to flick it away to mid-wicket for a single
full-toss outside the off and gets it off the bottom of the bat, gets to wide long-off for a couple
full-toss on his pads, pulled away to backward square-leg for a single, wanted a second but sent back by Hussey

swung away across the line, he was getting into the groove of hitting everything away, this time it's not hit off the middle of the bat, goes to Smith at deep square-leg and he tries to go for the catch, does not hold on to it
shorter this time, outside the off and slower one too, throws his bat at it, slogged to deep square-leg for a four

poor, poor ball and a good, good shot, full-toss from round the stumps and angling in, Raina almost had a smile on his face before he got that, easily stroked away over mid-wicket for a six to get to his 50
shorter and slower, almost never came on to the bat, he was looking to hit it up and over the off side, beats the shot
a very slow ball and he's looking to play it across the line, gets some bat through to long-on for a single
this is outside the off stump and right up to the bat and drilled through to deep covers for a single
fuller from the bowler yet again and Raina has tapped it through to long-off, again off the middle of the bat and cracked it well
was looking to give himself room, hit it over extra-cover but it's a tad quicker and gets an inside edge on to his pads, single taken
fullish this time and driven to long-off for a single
full-toss now and tapped back over the non-striker's head for a four, it was a straight-as-you-like bat and the shot just flew off it
and wow, just wow, that was pitched right up to the bat and he's bisected the two backward point fielders, the players were quite close to each other and he gets the gap so well!
well bowled that, yorker length and needed to dig it away, hit back to the bowler
shorter in length from Pollard and cut away through extra-cover for a couple of runs
fuller and on the middle stump, driven down to long-on for a single
continues bowling it short and he pulls again, not off the middle of the bat and straight to deep square-leg for a single
short of length and Hussey has hooked it away for a six! that was not at too much pace and the batsman has given it his all
gives himself some room and gets the ball on the middle stump, hits it through to long-off for a single
what a hit, that's almost a tee on a golf course, it was fuller outside the off and Hussey goes through with the shot through wide long-off for a four
good yorker that but Raina's waiting for that one, gets some bat on it to the leg side and off for a single
fullish delivery outside the off stump, driven to long-off for a single
wide outside the off stump and quite full, he was looking to dab it through the point area, gets no bat on it and through to the keeper, Malinga was the only one appealing there
it's very full length delivery outside the off stump and driven to deep cover for a single
yorker length delivery from Malinga, on the middle stump and tapped it to the leg side
round the wicket and fuller on his pads, easily tucked away to fine-leg for a single
cracked it away again, that was short and wide and Raina has thrown his bat over covers for a six yet again, and at the expense of being repetitive, that sounded so nice!
shorter in length and slower too, on his pads and tucked away to fine-leg for a couple of runs yet again, they are running well here
short of length and he pulls it to fine-leg for a single that brings up yet another half-century for Hussey, well played that!
shorter in length but it's outside the off stump and he swivels around to deep square-leg for a single
fuller from the bowler, on the middle stump and easily pushed down to wide long-on for a couple of runs, wasn't hit too hard and that allows them to come back for the second
on his pads and tucked away for a single to get the run-rate up to almost eight
whoa, up and over, well-timed by Raina, he got down to the pitch of the ball and went through the line of the stroke over extra-cover for a maximum!
on a length yet again from round the stumps, rocks back and taps it to deep covers for a single
shorter again and tapped down to deep cover for a single this time
quicker, shorter and on the off stump, pushed into the covers and Hussey wanted one, sent back by the batsman
shorter in length and tapped to deep covers for a single
crack, that's the sound that came off it, he was looking to chip down the pitch and he bowled it quicker, tapped it and that's gone over mid-wicket for a solid six!
and a reverse sweep again, this time it's fielded there and they get a single
amazing stroke that, too many of those cramping him up and he unleashes the reverse sweep, the delivery this time was on the off stump and goes to the backward point fence for a four!
tries to swing it away over the leg side, not too much bat on it and runs away on the bounce to the deep square-leg fielder
on his pads yet again but slightly fuller this time, cannot pull it away but unleashes the tap to the leg side for a single
short, on the leg stump, turning further down and pulled away to backward square-leg for a couple of runs
aah, tossed up yet again and driven through the covers for a single to get us to the half-way stage this innings
quicker and on his pads, flicked away to the leg side for a single
shortens his length completely now, tapped down to mid-wicket for a single
shorter in length and cut away, gets an inner edge to the covers for a single
shorter in length yet again and tapped to Johnson at point, quickly off for a single
slows it down and gently tosses it up, slightly shorter too and easily tucked away to the leg side for a single
shorter in length and easily pulled away by Raina to deep square-leg for a single, he was up on his toes for that one
on his pads this time, flicked away to deep square-leg for a single
this is quite wide and short too, wanted to cut it hard but I think it came on quicker than Hussey thought it would, beaten, the keeper's up to the bat too
short and fractionally wide, that's all Hussey needs to unleash the cut, gets it off the middle of the bat and very wide of both, the backward point and the third-man fielder
on the middle stump and on length too, it's hit straight down to long-on for a single
shorter in length and opens the face of the bat yet again, bit of an under-edge this time that runs through to short third-man for a single

edged and falls short of the very wide slip in place, that's the second edge that's gone to the wide slip fielder and on both occasions it's gone on the bounce, length ball and was probably looking to defend at it
and he loves playing that stroke doesn't he, Hussey waits till the last moment before opening the face of the bat and guides it down to third-man for a single
short of length outside the off and driven down to long-off for a single, gets off the mark
very close to the off stump and deftly played through to the third-man, steers it through for a single

swings, hits the bottom, and gone, caught! Vijay loves playing this free-swing shot, it was in his arc but not off the middle of the bat at all and it's gone straight to deep square-leg where it's taken, a wicket for Mumbai Indians
slower one outside the off stump, pushed it into the point region and straight to the fielder
fuller in length and driven down to long-off for a single, five singles off that one then
shorter in length and tucked round the corner for a single
attempts a sweep from outside the off and slips while playing the stroke, recovers well to not only complete the stroke but also get away for a single
immediately shortens his length and tapped away to the leg side for a single
reverse-swept this time, it was on his pads in an attempt to cramp him for room
fuller from round the stumps, gives it a bit of air, driven to the fielder in the covers
on his pads and tucked around the corner for a single, was ambling it out there before realising it's gone straight to the fielder, rushes in and is safely home before the throw comes in
shorter in length and tapped away to the mid-wicket for a single
on the off stump and tapped to the off side this time
what a shot, it's been hit inside out and lands a few inches in front of the extra-cover fence, ran down the track there to get to the pitch of the ball too
tosses it up from round the stumps, tapped to mid-wicket for a single, Harbhajan runs across to field that one
shorter in length and tapped away to the leg side for a single
another yorker and Vijay goes back, gets his boot out and defends it back to the bowler
swinging right into the batsman, wants to flick it away, but gets bit of a pad through to the leg side
slows the pace down but that's not slowing the pace of scoring down, he's read it well, waits for it and crunches it through the covers for a four
that's the second full-toss that Hussey's got and that's the second time he's got it away for a four, was on the off stump line and tapped through wide mid-off for a four
ooh, what a ball! it was an in-swinging yorker that from Malinga and the batsman had to jab his bat down rather quickly, runs away to short mid-wicket
well bowled and well played! it was on a length and there was a hint of swing away, not too pacy and he taps it well, down the ground and had it not been for a diving mid-off, was running away
shorter in length and tapped to short cover, straight to the fielder yet again, end of a good over from Harbhajan
slightly tossed up again and played well to square-leg, wanted a quick one but sent back by Vijay
was looking to go down the pitch, was quicker on his leg stump, trying to cramp him, pushed away to point in the end
too short again, enough for the batsman to go back and flick it away to mid-wicket for a single
shorter in length from round the stumps, tapped to square-leg, there's a fielder there
very full and tossed up nicely, driven down to long-off for a single
on the pads, tapped to the leg side for a single this time
was looking for a quick one there Hussey, had tapped it to the covers and called Vijay who remained rooted back, it had gone to Rohit who did well there, has a shy back too but Hussey's well in
shot that one, it was fuller outside the off stump and a tad wide, he drives it through point, beats Pollard and they are able to come back for the third, it looked timed very well
on a length and outside the off stump, bit of an angle away and pushed into the covers, followed by a loud shout of 'No!'
length ball but slightly closer to the stumps, on the middle and tapped to the mid-on area for a single

and now it's cut hard for a four, Hussey loves playing the cut to one that's short and wide and gets it over his favourite point fielder, Pollard, no chance of getting any hand to that one for the fielder

continues to bowl that same length and a bad line, on his pads too and easily tucked away to the right of that deep square-leg fielder, who has to run to it to stop it, couple of couple runs then to finish off the over
poor delivery again, this is further down on his pads and easily flicked away through mid-wicket for a couple of runs, there's a fielder at deep square-leg
aah, another good-looking drive off a length ball, tapped straight to the fielder but the pitch looks to be a good one this, for the batsmen that is

up and over and for a four, that was on a length yet again but he compensates by bowling outside the off stump, plays it through the line of the ball and hits it over extra-cover to get his second four
shortening of length but on the middle stump, it was quite gracefully flicked through square-leg for a four, nice
very full from Munaf and slightly slower, 127.8km/hr, he has a dash at it but hits it back to the bowler
fuller from Mitch and outside the off stump, Vijay's dabbed it to mid-off and springs away for a quick one
shortens his length this time and Hussey seemingly expected that, taps it to the off side for a quick single

edged this time and through to the third slip where Rohit fields, it was closer to the stumps this time, swinging away from the bat again and gets a nick trying to drive at it, falls short of the third slipper
and this one is slightly fuller from the bowler, outside the off stump too and swinging away from the batsman, lets it go through yet again
and now some swing, gets his line right this time, on the off stump, length ball and swings away from the batsman, the batsman does not fiddle with it
poor ball to start things off here, it was a full-toss on his pads and it's caressed through mid-wicket for a four!

and taken again, another good catch to finish things off for Chennai! was a slower one and he tries to go inside out and over the in-field, gets it away too but Bravo runs from mid-off to take the catch superbly to his right, it was a good 10 yards away too...goes for a nice, little sprint too after taking it.
fuller outside the off stump from round the stumps, driven to the covers

slower one and that's been taken again! he had no option but to slog it away, gets a bit of a top-edge and its gone very high, a lot of players were getting close to it, in the end it was Morris who was running back, takes it, very well too
full-toss and that's spanked through wide long-on for a four, Bravo throws himself to his right for some reason with the ball so wide off him
short of length again and he's cut it straight to the covers fielder, Hussey takes a simple catch and they have lost their number eight
shorter in length and dug back to the bowler, fielded by the bowler on his follow-through
full-toss from round the stumps and drilled down to long-off for a single

short of length and that's a ripper of a catch from Raina! shorter in length and he goes for the cut, does not hit off the middle of the bat and it lobs up, for a long, long time it looked like it was getting away from Raina, who makes a sprint for it towards his right and grabs hold of it like it's his life!
pulls back the pace a lot and he waits for it to arrive, pulls it away to long-on for a single
very full from Bravo and it's on his leg stump, chipped to long-on, goes on the bounce to the fielder
shorter in length and pulled away to the leg side for a single
length ball outside the off stump and smacked back past the bowler, the fielder runs across well, then fumbles before recovering to throw it back
very full from the bowler and digs it out, straight back to the bowler who does not get his hand to it and rolls over to the hit the stumps
oh, that's a no-ball over his waist, almost his head high, does well to sway away and the bowler immediately apologises for it
a very high full-toss, was on the off stump and hit over to wide long-off this time
full-toss and outside the off stump, drilled through to the extra-cover for a single, a direct hit would have found him short
fuller and wider outside the off stump, wants to drill it away but misses, goes through to the keeper

edged and dropped! Dhoni's dropped a fairly straight-forward chance, he was looking to pull away a length ball and gets an edge that flies to the left of Dhoni who gets some glove on it, but sneaks through.
short of length and that's been pulled straight to the backward square-leg area, easily caught by Vijay
shortens his length and he was looking to go back, in the end it's too close to the batsman and he only defends it back
ooh, short of length ball and a quicker one too, was looking to play it down, almost fend it away, misses the bat and goes through to the keeper
short of length and cut away through the covers for a single
outside the off stump and driven to point, straight to the fielder
fuller and driven back to the bowler, ending a very good over from Jadeja, who's ended with three wickets

gone, Jadeja has his third, Pollard's walking back! it was fired on to his pads and that's flicked away to the leg side, there's a fielder inside the circle, Hussey takes a good, low catch to send back the big West Indies, that's excellent bowling and good captaincy to have a fielder there!
shorter in length and cut for a single to deep covers
whoa, that' been hit as powerfully as I have seen tonight, was on a length and smashed but the fielder is very straight at long-off and fields well
two in a row now, this wasn't too full, was a length ball, quicker, flatter and he's thrown his bat at it again, six more!
gone for a six, was pitched right up but gave him room there, not up to the block-hole, the free swing helps
fuller from the bowler for a change against Pollard but it's on his pads and he flicks it to deep square-leg for a single
shortens his length and he opens the face of the bat to tap it away for a single to the off side
again outside the off stump, slightly fuller this time and cracked it to long-on for a single
and now wants to pull it away, was on a length and angling away, misses it
slows the pace down from round the stumps, was shorter too, he defends it to the leg side
short of length and he's pushed it to the leg side for a quick single, for a milli-second Pollard had doubts about it but gets through
pushes it into the covers this time for a single
slapped through to wide long-off but it's hit so hard that once it was fielded by Vijay - and done well at that - there was no chance for a second
fuller outside the off stump and driven down to long-off for a single
closer to the stumps, on the middle, quicker and tapped to the leg side for a single
very full and left alone by the batsman thinking it would be a wide outside off, not given
outside edged for a four! that was on the off stump and quicker, probably a bit of spin too and he throws his bat at it, gets over point for a four

down the track and hits it straight to Bravo at long-off! it was a length ball that probably jagged slightly back into the batsman, he was looking to go down the track and smash it over the top, gets somewhere closer to the splice than the meat and it's hit down his throat, big wicket this
shorter in length and angling into the batsman, pushes it into the covers
shorter in length and tucked away to the deep square-leg fielder for a single
very full from the bowler this time, after a couple of shorter one, digs it out well and gets it through to third-man for a single
shorter in length again and outside the off stump, cracks it away through the off side, but straight to the point fielder
shorter in length and he was looking to play it away to the leg side, misses the bat and hits the pads, rolls to the off side for a leg-bye
shorter in length and outside the off stump, he was looking to hit it away, gets only an insude edge to the leg side for a single
shorter in length and punched down to long-off for a single
fuller on the off stump and gets his bat out and drives through to long-off for a single

gone this time, he was looking to sweep it away and misses, the ball hits the pads and given out lbw! Karthik's not very happy with the decision and the only thing that could have been a bother was an inside edge, couldn't make out any inside edge there on replays there
goes down the track and caresses it to long-on, the bowler does well to run across and stall it at a single
fuller from round the stumps, flicked away to deep square-leg, the fielder from fine-leg had to come across there and they get a second
fuller on his pads, deftly tucked away to deep square-leg for a single
short, wide and cut away to deep point for a single
and now wants to go down the track and hit it over the in-field, not off the middle of the bat though
on his pads and tapped away to the fielder
almost to the fielder, he was looking to tap it to the leg side, straight to the short mid-wicket fielder but just short
shortens the length and pushed to the leg side, Raina dives from extra-cover and fields it
on a length and it's pushed down to long-off for a single
quicker, on the middle stump and tapped to the off side
straighter from round the stumps and defended back to the bowler
fuller on the off stump, driven through the off side for a single, was turning away from the bat

and this is gone now, Jadeja comes in and strikes! it was not as full as he would have wanted it to be, pulls back the length, was looking to tonk it over the leg side but gets an outside, thick edge that spoons up for Raina to take a straight-forward catch
fuller on the middle stump and drives it inside out to deep cover for a single
and now expects it to be a shorter one, goes back to cut it away, straight to the fielder
and he can dab them to the fence too, was fuller and for a moment one thought he was looking to reverse but plays the deft sweep through fine-leg for a four
outside the off stump, probably slightly quicker but he opens his stance up and pummels it over the bowler for a six, straight enough to hit the sight-screen
very full and straight, easily dug away to mid-wicket for a single, oh wait, they are coming back for the second now and get it easily too!
on a length on the middle stump, tucked around the corner for a single to square-leg
tossed it up from round the stumps, driven down to long-on for a single
now he corrects his length and bowls full, yorker length, dug out towards long on
length delivery, in his arc and this has been spanked over long on, way deep into the stands
slows down the pace and taps to the off side, wants a single does Karthik but is sent back by Smith
was looking to defend at it off the front foot, gets an inside edge through to the leg side for a couple of runs
there was a long-off and a long-on in place for Smith, there was a fielder at deep mid-wicket too, but he's been doled out a quick, short one, he's pulled hard and pulled long for a six!
short of length on the off stump line, tapped to the off side for a quick single to bring Smith back on strike
missed! that was one of the worst balls he could have bowled, full-toss and on the pads, probably a tad too high for Smith to flick it away and gets bit of a leading edge through to long-on
spanked, back over the bowler and despite the presence of a long-on fielder, he's beaten him for a four, was a length ball, he gives himself room and smashes him!
no, he's not changing his line and Smith's got the hang of it, gets it over mid-wicket, and helps himself to an easy boundary
continues to bowl that line and again, Smith gets it off the middle of the bat through to deep square-leg for a couple of runs, Jadeja gets the ball in quick
finally, he's been drifting too many down on his pads and Smith's been missing 'em, this time he gets it off the middle of the bat and gets it through backward square-leg for a four
shorter in length and on the off stump line, pushed to mid-off

fuller on the middle stump and that's flicked away to wide mid-on, that looked to be going through for a four before a diving, orange-capped Hussey stops it, should have been a single but Smith sends Karthik back and he has to dive back in to get home
shorter, slower, read well too and cut hard, badly placed though, straight to the point fielder
was looking to paddle it over short fine-leg this time, was outside the off stump and skids on to the batsman, misses his bat and hits his pads, was outside the line of the off stump
pitched up but outside the off stump, thought it was not too quick either, and driven through the covers for a single, fielded well by Raina
pulls it back now, a deliberate bouncer, which is a good idea actually, but Smith hooks it over fine-leg for another six! two in two and now it gets interesting...
up and over and for a six, that's a rather long one that! was fuller on the middle stump and like many of the others that's been crunched over the bowler's head for a six!
and again, how many of these have been pitched right up to the bat but on his pads and how many has he missed! again hits his pads and rolls over to the off side
short of length and tucked away to the leg side for a single
drifts on to his pads this time, fuller too and wants to flick it away, misses, hits his pads and the batsmen rush across for a leg-bye
that's fuller and it's been given a serious tap through mid-off for a four, was hit straighter too and to the right of the fielder there
down the leg side and he was looking to pull it away, was short enough to do that too but it angles further down and does not get any bat on it, through to the keeper for a wide
short of length and he pulls it away but does not come off the middle of the ball, rolls over to the leg side for a single
fuller on his pads and tucked away to deep mid-wicket for a single
finally slaps it in the gap, he had been timing them well but it was the placement which was a problem, this was placed through extra-cover for a four
and this time he gets it off the middle of the bat, length ball and he drives it through the line but it's hit hard and straight to mid-off, no chance of a single
outside the off stump and tapped straight to point, yet to get off the mark here Karthik
and that nips away slightly, was on a length and he was looking to drive through the line, misses the outside edge
outside the off stump and on a length, pushed into the covers where it goes straight to the fielder
shortens his length and pushes into the covers, gets away for a quick single
shortens his length and that's slow as well, was looking to flick it away but gets it back to the bowler who skips over to his right to field it
fuller from the bowler and that's defended off the front foot to the off side

and now he's gone, caught at mid-on! was looking to get it over the in-field yet again, it was full enough to smash it but the ball did not smack the middle of the bat and it's lobbed gently for the fielder at mid-on, straight-forward catch pouched there

he was looking to go over the top there, gives himself room by going across to the leg stump, hits it over mid-off alright but gets a little more elevation than he would have liked, Morris gives it a good chase and pulls it back
fuller on his pads and looks to flick it away, misses the bat and hits his pads, rolls back to the bowler and he still wants a single, sees it early enough and gets back
full-toss on the middle stump and almost surprises the batsman, hits it back to him off the toe of the bat and rolls over to mid-off
the third-man's up inside the circle and he looks to dab it through that area, gets it away to deep backward point region for a single
and now has a flay at it, was slightly shorter and outside the off stump, was looking to hit it on the up but beaten through to the keeper
aah, shot again, this was his first ball and it was short and wide, cracks it through the covers for a four, bisected too and hit powerfully
on a length this time but closer to the stumps, middle stump line, tapped to the mid-on area for a single
crunched, we have heard some superb sounds off the bat tonight and this is one of them, on a length and outside the off stump, cracked through extra-cover
fuller on the off stump and he gets his bat and pad out and defends it back to the bowler
